claims.text: The DeepSeek LLM paper establishes the early DeepSeek language-model family baseline before MLA and DeepSeekMoE became defining later architecture branches.

limitations.text: This retained evidence note does not restate every model-size or distribution detail requested by Screening; later efficiency claims are sourced to DeepSeek-V2 and subsequent artifacts.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

targets.target: Verify the DeepSeek LLM baseline, model sizes, release context, and open-weight distribution from primary material.
targets.finding: The bound primary paper verifies the early family baseline and release context, but this Evidence pass does not independently lock every requested size and distribution detail; those details are not needed for Architecture selection.
